audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart shows blanket 'Skill' for levels 1 through 6 while the content layer and packet both say Brand wins all five early rows.
audit.why: Brand's W 900 range + Blaze stacking out-poke Ryze's 615-range kit pre-items; packet levelChart agrees.
audit.corrected: phases[0-4].side moved to Brand with grounded whys.

audit.why: Spikes (Brand 3-5 stun window, Pyroclasm at 6, Ryze Archangel's flip at first item) match both kits.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1] claims Ryze cycles Q 'to keep the passive shield loaded' — current Ryze passive has no shield; Q with 2 runes grants Move Speed. Cooldowns field has no digit.
audit.why: Kit text: 'When Ryze casts Overload with 2 runes charged, he gains a brief burst of Move Speed.' Sear is 8s rank 1, Pyroclasm 100s.
audit.corrected: Bullet rewritten around the rune Move Speed burst; cooldowns rewritten with 8s/100s.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. It governs your forward steps. - W Rune Prison spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Brand Sear (Stun): 8s at rank 1 — it only stuns while you are ablaze, so after eating W or E the stun line is the dodge that matters. - W Rune Prison spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Pyroclasm is 100s — his kill threat halves whenever it's down.

edits.before: Cycle Q to keep the passive shield loaded
edits.after: Cycle E and W to keep Overload charged

edits.before: E the wave, Q the flux bounce, and W-root if he steps to answer — three-spell trades that end before his combo starts.
edits.after: Your basics reset Q and charge runes — at two charges Overload grants a speed burst, the sidestep that dodges his 8s Sear.

edits.before: Spending W on poke and then face-tanking the engage it was born to stop — rootless Ryze is a Tear with a health bar.
edits.after: At half HP one Sear into Pillar kills you through Blaze — with W down you have no stop button, so reset or hug the turret.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP doubles the thesis. Nothing else is defensible on him.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP feeds the same map plan. Nothing else is defensible on him.

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Brand wins by stacking Blaze with Pillar and Conflagration, then stunning you with Sear the moment you are ablaze.

edits.before: Q-farm at max range — your level 1 is honest at best. Bank Tear stacks and give nothing away.
edits.after: Pillar out-ranges your Q and every hit stacks Blaze — farm at max range and give nothing away.

edits.before: W online: the point-blank root answers anyone who closes. Trade Q-W-Q only when his engage tool is down.
edits.after: W online, but his W-Q chunks you before you reach 615 root range — answer only when Sear is down.

edits.before: E unlocks the real combo: E-Q flux chunks and the wave-bounce clears. The lane starts being yours to play.
edits.after: E unlocks E-Q flux poke, but with Blaze ticking he still wins the straight trade — poke, then disengage.

edits.before: Tear + Lost Chapter and the EQ machine hums — short-trade his every wave contact and walk away before the answer.
edits.after: Tear + Lost Chapter and the EQ machine hums, but his full combo still nearly kills you — short-trade and leave.

edits.before: Realm Warp online — you are now a map play waiting to happen. The lane is a timer: shove and warp somewhere profitable.
edits.after: Realm Warp online, but Pyroclasm wins the head-on fight — shove and warp somewhere profitable instead of duelling.

notes: win[0-4] already read Brand, so side edits go alone per the chart rule (no no-op win edits). Ratings left at current values — no ground to move a number precisely; if QA wants Brand-side ratings above 5/10 that is a judgment call. tldr's 'your root and shield win the rest' reads as a Seraph's-shield reference and was left. sectionsMissing: breakdown.difficulty stock rating sentence.
